captured: 2026-11-15, 1440x900, single page, cookie banner declined before capture

taste.name: Two surfaces, no containers
taste.trigger: When grouping many content blocks on a long marketing page
taste.decision: Chose full-bleed swaps between two surfaces (#F9F3F0 cream, #00615F teal) over cards, borders or shadows
taste.reason: Because a whole-width colour change reads as a new chapter at a glance, without the visual noise of boxed tiles

taste.name: A shouting voice used sparingly
taste.trigger: When the brand needed energy without making long text tiring
taste.decision: Chose a condensed 900-weight uppercase display face for 3 roles only (h1, h3, footer wordmark) over one face doing everything
taste.reason: Because a loud short line gets noticed, and the plain body face keeps the 16px/24px reading text easy

taste.name: Real food, real people, square corners
taste.trigger: When proving that the product is about actual local shops
taste.decision: Chose unrounded photographs of people and food in 1:1 tiles over illustrations or rounded thumbnails
taste.reason: Because a raw rectangular photo reads as a document of a real place, a rounded one reads as an app asset

taste.name: Colour change is the only motion
taste.trigger: When adding feedback to nav and buttons
taste.decision: Chose 240-300ms colour and opacity fades over transform, bounce or scale effects
taste.reason: Because the page is selling calm everyday habits; nothing should jump
evidence: transitions animate background-color, color, opacity, filter only
